CSS

States and numbers

What the app tells the CSS of each part, to style it by what it is and where it is.

States

ClassWhen
.is-focusedIt has the focus (a card, a button, a key, a menu entry…)
.is-currentThe item a list is at, with the focus or not
.has-focusA list with the focus; an element of a scrolling group with the focus inside
.is-above, .is-belowThe elements of a scrolling group before and after the one shown
.is-onThe section shown, a switch on
.is-primaryThe main button (Play)
.is-shown, .is-before, .is-afterThe sections: shown, left of it, right of it
.is-covered, .is-leavingA screen under another; a screen going

Attributes

On .rp-desk: data-tab (home, systems, favorites, search), data-screen (the screen on top: also games, game), data-device (pad, keys, mouse), data-pad (xbox, playstation, nintendo, none), data-variant, data-focus-system (the system of the focus), data-screen-system, data-theme-id, data-opt-…. On elements: data-el, data-focused; on lists data-layout, data-source. On items and games: data-system, data-installed, data-favorite, data-kind. On buttons: data-action.

/* Installed games brighter, with the joypad only */
.rp-desk[data-device='pad'] .rp-card:not([data-installed]) { opacity: 0.55; }

Numbers

VariableOnWhat it is
--ithe items of listsIts place in its list: 0, 1, 2…
--relthe sameWhere it is from the focus: …−2, −1, 0, 1, 2…
--distthe sameHow far from the focus: 0, 1, 2…
--focus, --count, --colslistsWhere the focus is, how many, the columns of a grid
--row, --colthe items of a gridIts row and column
--block-rel, --scrollscrolling groupsWhere an element is from the one shown; how far it slid
--hsystemsThe hue of the system, 0 to 360

They are numbers: use them in calc(), and animate them (transition: --rel 300ms). The list places each item; turn it, lift it or light it with them:

.my-row .rp-item {
  transform: rotateY(calc(clamp(-1, var(--rel), 1) * -50deg));
  scale: calc(1 - var(--dist) * 0.07);
}
